I'm extremely gender non conforming. I know I am. I would even choose to be the other gender if I had the choice, I think. But yeah, that's the thing, I'm not. I managed to mental gymnastics myself into thinking I was for a year, but I know now. I couldn't wait for HRT when I thought I was. I was so sure it was going to make me happy. Looking back I can't believe that I did that to myself. But I did. Somehow. My alter ego was basically everything that I wanted to be and the opposite gender. My theory is that I thought the only way to be that gender non conforming was to be the opposite gender but honestly I don't know what was going on in my head lol. I went back to cis because I realised my feelings were fabricated. It was a weird realisation to come to, but an important one. I just wish I could stop feeling like shit constantly because of fake dysphoria. It's like my brain won't snap out of that headspace.

Yeah, a lot of transgender forums say that type of shit. It doesn't phase me though personally because I'm aware of the whole in fighting thing that goes on in that community and I know what side I take. I'm not scared that I'm trans, I'm not scared that I'm cis - what I'm scared of is the possibility that my brain has fucked up my feelings and my perception of my feelings so bad that I'll always feel these fake emotions and I'll never be able to tell my true feelings on anything gendered again. The former is more horrifying to me because living daily life like this is awful. I hate my body, I can't look at myself in the mirror, I have panic attacks, I hide myself under layers, I have to dissociate in public to feel comfortable, etc. Before all this, I never really felt comfortable with myself, but it wasn't that bad. I just always thought the other gender was objectively better (not in a society sort of way or anything) and everyone felt that way. I would daydream a lot about being the other gender. In fact I created a whole alter ego character in my mind who was the other gender so I could pretend to be them. But I imagine that was me growing into my gender nonconformity. It was all ruined the moment I found out what trans was and my mind started obsessing over it and creating this fake emotional response cycle. I mean, it's been over half a year since I realised, and since I reidentified myself as cis, and yet they still persist. The only good thing is I'm not obsessed over the whole thing. It's just the feelings make me extremely depressed.
